elements.element: Renewal must occur either solely by mutual written agreement or automatically for successive 12-month terms.
elements.evidence: The clause provides automatic renewal for additional one-year terms, satisfying the permitted automatic-renewal alternative.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer must be permitted to opt out on 30 days' written notice.
elements.evidence: Either Party, which includes Customer, may “elect not to renew” upon 30 days' written notice. Although “following the Initial Term” creates some timing ambiguity, the language reasonably applies to renewals following the Initial Term.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Vendor must remind Customer 60 days before each renewal.
elements.evidence: “Kubient shall notify Customer 60 days before each renewal.”

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, renewal price increases must be capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
elements.evidence: “Renewal fees shall not increase more than the lesser of CPI and 3%.”
The agreement “will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms.”

elements.element: The non-renewal notice window must be no more than 60 days.
elements.evidence: Either Party may elect not to renew upon 30 days' written notice, which is within the 60-day maximum.

elements.element: Renewal price increases must not exceed 5%.
elements.evidence: The lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap necessarily limits increases to no more than 3%, and therefore no more than 5%.

result.reason: The operative language satisfies the preferred automatic-renewal route and all fallback requirements. It is not minimal because it also shortens either party's post-Initial-Term convenience-termination notice from 90 to 30 days and gives Kubient an express non-renewal right, neither of which is necessary to provide Customer's required opt-out. Unrelated terms remain operative and no clear contradiction is introduced. Drafting quality is weak because “following the Initial Term” leaves the first non-renewal election timing less explicit than a direct requirement to give notice at least 30 days before expiration, and “notify Customer” does not expressly state the required content of the reminder.
